parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

> The end time must be later than the start time.

parameters.name: Filters
parameters.description: A list of query filter conditions.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the filter parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the database instance.

parameters.name: NodeId
parameters.description:
The node ID.

> For PolarDB for MySQL instances, you must specify the node ID.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time as a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.
